warypredators.config.title: Wary Predators
warypredators.config.predators_enabled.t: Master toggle for bears, big cats, wolves, and crocodiles. If off, all predators attack on sight exactly like vanilla TFC.
warypredators.config.default_provoke_dis: Fallback: how close (in blocks) a visible player must be before an unlisted predator considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly regardless.
warypredators.config.default_attack_chan: Fallback attack chance (0-1) for unlisted predators. 1 = always commits when you're in range; 0 = never initiates on its own.
warypredators.config.default_break_off_c: Fallback per-second chance (0-1) an unlisted predator loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = never voluntarily disengages.
warypredators.config.grizzly_bear.provok: Defensive charger: not hunting you, but charges hard if you enter its space. How close (blocks) before it considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.grizzly_bear.attack: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.grizzly_bear.break_: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.black_bear.provoke_: Wary: almost always flees; the rare attack is a determined predatory stalk. How close (blocks) before it considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.black_bear.attack_c: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.black_bear.break_of: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.polar_bear.provoke_: Pursuit predator: treats humans as prey and comes at you from range — the boldest bear. How close (blocks) before it considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.polar_bear.attack_c: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.polar_bear.break_of: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.cougar.provoke_dist: Ambush cat: lets you get close, then commits to a pounce. A short distance here means it won't trigger until you're already close. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.cougar.attack_chanc: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.cougar.break_off_ch: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.panther.provoke_dis: Ambush cat (a cougar variant in TFC): strikes at close range. A short distance here means it won't trigger until you're already close. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.panther.attack_chan: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.panther.break_off_c: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.lion.provoke_distan: Bold apex predator: mostly avoids people, but a real man-eater. How close (blocks) before it considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly.
Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.lion.break_off_chan: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.sabertooth.provoke_: Extinct — modeled as a fearless apex ambusher (speculative). How close (blocks) before it considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.sabertooth.attack_c: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.sabertooth.break_of: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.tiger.provoke_dista: The apex man-eater: stalks and ambushes from range. How close (blocks) before it considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.tiger.attack_chance: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.tiger.break_off_cha: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.crocodile.provoke_d: Ambush from the water's edge: short range, near-total commit, no escape. A short distance here means it explodes on you once you're close. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.crocodile.attack_ch: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.crocodile.break_off: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.wolf.provoke_distan: Wary: overwhelmingly avoids humans; brief investigative approaches it rarely presses. How close (blocks) before it considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly.
Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. Kept low so wolves usually decline. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s.
warypredators.config.wolf.break_off_chan: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. Kept high so a wolf often abandons an investigative approach.
warypredators.config.hyena.provoke_dista: Bolder than a wolf, especially at night, but usually wary of people. How close (blocks) before it considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.hyena.attack_chance: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.hyena.break_off_cha: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.direwolf.provoke_di: Extinct — a bold pack hunter with no fear of humans (speculative). How close (blocks) before it considers attacking. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.direwolf.attack_cha: Odds (0-1) it commits once you're within provoke distance. On a miss it leaves you alone for ~15s instead of re-rolling.
warypredators.config.direwolf.break_off_: Per-second odds (0-1) it loses interest mid-hunt. 0 = fights until TFC's normal disengage.
warypredators.config.rammers_enabled.too: Master toggle for boar, moose, wildebeest, and bison. If off, all four ram exactly as in vanilla TFC.
warypredators.config.rammers_retaliate.t: If on, hitting a ramming animal (even with a thrown spear, from any range) makes it turn and charge you back for a while. Vanilla TFC never reacts to ranged hits.
warypredators.config.rammers_retaliate_s: How long a provoked ramming animal keeps pursuing and charging the player who hit it.
warypredators.config.default_ram_distanc: Fallback ram distance (blocks) for any ramming animal not listed individually.
Fallback ram chance (0-1) for any ramming animal not listed individually.
warypredators.config.boar.ram_distance.t: Aggressive and readily provoked: how close (blocks) a player must be before a boar considers charging. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.boar.ram_chance.too: Odds (0-1) a boar commits to a ram once you're in range. Boars are vicious — kept high.
Not a hunter, but genuinely dangerous when approached — injures more people than bears in parts of Alaska. Stands its ground and charges if you get close. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.moose.ram_chance.to: Odds (0-1) a moose charges once you're in range. Kept high — moose commit readily when their space is breached.
Flees at a distance but charges hard once you're close — the top cause of animal injuries in Yellowstone. Short trigger, powerful commit. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.bison.ram_chance.to: Odds (0-1) a bison charges once you're within its (short) ram distance. Kept high.
warypredators.config.wildebeest.ram_dist: Skittish prey animal that almost always flees; very rarely charges a human. Short trigger. Being hit always provokes instantly.
warypredators.config.wildebeest.ram_chan: Odds (0-1) a wildebeest charges once you're in range. Kept low — they overwhelmingly flee instead.
warypredators.config.defenders_enabled.t: Master toggle for cow, yak, musk ox, goat, and pig. OFF by default (opt-in). Turn on to let them fight back when attacked instead of only fleeing.
warypredators.config.defenders_burst_sec: How long a defending animal keeps fighting after being hit. Each new hit you land refreshes it, so if you keep attacking it keeps fighting.
Whether the cow fights back when attacked, instead of only fleeing.
warypredators.config.cow.defend_damage.t: Cattle can hurt a careless person. When struck it turns and butts you, and keeps at it if you keep hitting. Damage per blow (2.0 = one heart).
Whether the yak fights back when attacked, instead of only fleeing.
warypredators.config.yak.defend_damage.t: A big, sturdy bovine. Struck, it wheels around and shoves back, pressing on if you keep attacking. Damage per blow (2.0 = one heart).
warypredators.config.musk_ox.defend_enab: Whether the musk ox fights back when attacked, instead of only fleeing.
warypredators.config.musk_ox.defend_dama: Famously defensive - it stands its ground and hits hard. The toughest of the passive defenders. Damage per blow (2.0 = one heart).
warypredators.config.goat.defend_enabled: Whether the goat fights back when attacked, instead of only fleeing.
Goats headbutt. A light but real jab that keeps coming if you keep provoking it. Damage per blow (2.0 = one heart).
Whether the pig fights back when attacked, instead of only fleeing.
warypredators.config.pig.defend_damage.t: Pigs are scrappier than they look. Hit one and it comes back at you rather than only fleeing. Damage per blow (2.0 = one heart).
warypredators.config.defenders_familiari: Livestock this familiar with you (or more) won't fight back - they trust you and just flee. TFC familiarity is 0 to 1; 0.3 is where an animal bonds enough to breed. Set above 1 to make even fully-tame animals defend themselves.
